title: Vetrivel Sakthivel
desc: Despite having cleared the IPS exam, Sakthivel's father asks him to work in their clothing store. He falls in love with Manju, but her dark past and her father become obstacles to their love.

title: En Mana Vaanil
desc: A man with a disability falls in love with an affluent girl with a hearing and speech impairment. When they elope, her fiancé tries to separate the duo.

title: Poove Poochooda Vaa
desc: Poongavanathamma, an elderly woman, lives alone. However, when her granddaughter comes to live with her, her life completely changes.

title: Pooveli
desc: When a man helps his classmate after the death of her lover, her family mistakes him for her husband. But the girl tries to make her family hate him so that he can go on with his life.

title: Iruttu
desc: After mysterious and unnatural deaths happen near a police station that he is taking in charge, a new police officer begins his investigation to unravel the mystery surrounding these events.
